_about: Public-domain John Cumming (1807-1881), minister of the Scottish National Church, Crown Court, London, preacher on prophecy and controversialist against Rome, for the Word Hoard: Is Christianity from God? (1849 printing), Tractarianism and Popery (1843), Apocalyptic Sketches (1854 printing), Voices of the Night (1850), God in History (1852), Lectures for the Times (1851), Lectures on the Seven Churches (1852), The Church before the Flood (1853), Foreshadows on the miracles, Lectures on Romanism (1854), The Great Sacrifice (1854), The Comforter (1854), Benedictions (1854), The Tent and the Altar (1854), Signs of the Times (1855), The End (1855), Infant Salvation (1855), The Last of the Patriarchs (1856), Sabbath Morning and Evening Readings on Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Matthew, Mark and Luke, and Moses Right and Bishop Colenso Wrong (1863). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 65 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
